risk_flags.description: Confidence in this route, not danger in the request: HIGH_RISK_ROUTE when the chosen workflow is itself STRICT, AMBIGUOUS_ROUTE when a competing workflow scored close.

bypass_language.description: Waiver phrases found in the objective, as CATEGORY:phrase. Evidence, not a verdict: it authorises nothing, and an empty array means these phrases were not found, not that no bypass was demanded. Optional, so RouteDecisions produced before it existed stay valid.
